title: 和我一起玩吧
source_note: 英文依官网完整原画逐页核对，OCR只作辅助；合并排版换行并统一弯引号。无字页新增串词单列，不冒充原作正文。

pages.text_original: All Jabu wants to do is play. What can he do?
Diketo! But who can play with him?
“Mama, come and play with me.” But Mama is cooking pap and spinach.
“Baba, come and play with me.” But Baba is busy digging a big hole.
“Zwe, come and play with me.” But his brother is busy reading.
Jabu sits outside. He wants to play diketo! But there is no one to play with.
So he plays alone. It’s not so bad! He digs a small hole in the earth. Then he puts ten small stones inside the hole.
So much fun! Dad sees Jabu and stops digging his big hole.
Mama comes out with some pap and spinach.
Zwe looks out the window and sees everyone. He doesn’t want to miss out on all the fun. So he goes to join them.
Jabu and his family smile together.
At last, Jabu has people to play with.
